comment: Agent I's SQL-bearing corpus (research/embedding-text.md). Standalone: golden warehouse tables and collections, none of the golden entities. Cards carry native SQL or MBQL; many have vague names and no description, so their meaning is only in the query. Hand-written; authored with a script, but this JSON is the source of truth.

tables.name: fct_orders_v2
tables.description: Order line facts, one row per order line. Includes net amount after discounts and refunds, channel, currency and FX-converted EUR amount. Replaced fct_orders in 2025.

tables.name: fct_orders
tables.description: DEPRECATED. Legacy order header table, gross amounts only. Use fct_orders_v2.

tables.name: dim_customer
tables.description: One row per customer account, with signup date, country, acquisition channel and lifetime order count.

tables.name: dim_product
tables.description: Product catalog: SKU, category, season, cost price and list price.

tables.name: fct_returns
tables.description: Returned order lines with RMA number, return reason code and refund amount.

tables.name: fct_web_sessions
tables.description: Clickstream sessions from the web shop, with landing page, UTM source and whether the session converted.

tables.name: fct_marketing_spend
tables.description: Daily paid media spend by channel and campaign (Google, Meta, TikTok, affiliates).

tables.name: fct_support_tickets
tables.description: Zendesk tickets with category, priority, first response time and resolution time.

tables.name: fct_shipments
tables.description: Parcels handed to carriers (DHL, InPost, Yamato, UPS) with promised and actual delivery dates.

tables.name: dim_warehouse
tables.description: Distribution centres: Poznań, Rotterdam, Reno and Chiba.

tables.name: fct_inventory_snapshot
tables.description: Daily on-hand stock per SKU per warehouse.

tables.name: fct_subscriptions
tables.description: Trail Club membership subscriptions: start, cancel date, plan and monthly price.

tables.name: hr_employees
tables.description: Employee roster from the HRIS: department, location, start date, manager.

tables.name: hr_terminations
tables.description: Leavers with termination date and voluntary or involuntary flag.

tables.name: fct_payments
tables.description: Card and wallet payments captured through Adyen, including chargebacks and payment method.

tables.name: stg_adyen_settlements
tables.description: Raw Adyen settlement report rows, loaded nightly. Not for reporting.

tables.name: dim_wholesale_account
tables.description: B2B retail partners, their tier, credit limit and account manager.

tables.name: fct_wholesale_orders
tables.description: Purchase orders from retail partners, with PO number and requested ship window.

tables.name: gdpr_dsr_requests
tables.description: Data subject requests (access, erasure, rectification) and their SLA status.

tables.name: fct_nps_responses
tables.description: Post-purchase survey responses with 0-10 score and free-text comment.

entities.name: Query 17
entities.sql:
select c.country, count(distinct r.rma_number) as refunds, sum(r.refund_amount) as refunded
from analytics.fct_returns r
join analytics.fct_orders_v2 o on o.order_line_id = r.order_line_id
join analytics.dim_customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
where r.returned_at >= date_trunc('quarter', now()) - interval '3 months'
  and r.returned_at < date_trunc('quarter', now())
group by 1 order by 3 desc

entities.name: copy of revenue v2
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', ordered_at) as month, channel, sum(net_amount_eur) as revenue_eur
from analytics.fct_orders_v2
where discount_code is null
group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

entities.name: tmp jan
entities.sql:
select discount_code, count(distinct order_id) as orders, sum(net_amount_eur) as revenue
from analytics.fct_orders_v2
where discount_code is not null and extract(month from ordered_at) = 1
group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: Ben's q
entities.sql:
select acquisition_channel,
       avg(case when lifetime_orders > 1 then 1.0 else 0 end) as repeat_share,
       count(*) as customers
from analytics.dim_customer group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: Query 3
entities.sql:
select carrier,
       100.0 * sum(case when delivered_date > promised_date then 1 else 0 end) / count(*) as pct_late
from analytics.fct_shipments where delivered_date is not null
group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: Query 8
untitled (1)
entities.sql:
select method, avg(case when is_chargeback then 1.0 else 0 end) as chargeback_rate, count(*) as payments
from analytics.fct_payments group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: export for Marta
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', captured_at) as month, method,
       100 * sum(fee_eur) / nullif(sum(amount_eur), 0) as fee_pct
from analytics.fct_payments group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

entities.name: Query 21
entities.sql:
select plan, count(*) as early_cancellations
from analytics.fct_subscriptions
where cancelled_at is not null and cancelled_at < started_at + interval '30 days'
group by 1

entities.name: sub stuff
entities.sql:
select plan, sum(monthly_price_eur) as mrr_eur, count(*) as active_subs
from analytics.fct_subscriptions where cancelled_at is null
group by 1

entities.name: q_final_final
entities.sql:
select e.department,
       sum(case when t.voluntary then 1 else 0 end) as resigned,
       sum(case when not t.voluntary then 1 else 0 end) as let_go
from analytics.hr_terminations t join analytics.hr_employees e using (employee_id)
where t.termination_date >= current_date - interval '12 months'
group by 1

entities.name: headcount thing
entities.sql:
select e.location, count(*) as employees
from analytics.hr_employees e
left join analytics.hr_terminations t using (employee_id)
where t.employee_id is null
group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: Query 44
entities.sql:
select priority, count(*) filter (where first_response_minutes > 60) as sla_breaches, count(*) as tickets
from analytics.fct_support_tickets group by 1

entities.name: zendesk pull
entities.sql:
select category, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by resolution_minutes) / 60.0 as median_hours
from analytics.fct_support_tickets where resolution_minutes is not null
group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: Query 5
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', responded_at) as month,
       100.0 * (avg(case when score >= 9 then 1.0 else 0 end) - avg(case when score <= 6 then 1.0 else 0 end)) as nps
from analytics.fct_nps_responses group by 1 order by 1

entities.name: nps comments
entities.sql:
select responded_at, score, comment
from analytics.fct_nps_responses
where score <= 6 and (comment ilike '%late%' or comment ilike '%delivery%' or comment ilike '%slow%')
order by responded_at desc

entities.name: Query 12
entities.sql:
select w.name as warehouse, i.sku
from analytics.fct_inventory_snapshot i join analytics.dim_warehouse w using (warehouse_id)
where i.snapshot_date = (select max(snapshot_date) from analytics.fct_inventory_snapshot) and i.on_hand_units = 0
order by 1, 2

entities.name: inv v3
Query 30
entities.sql:
select a.account_manager, count(*) as overdue_pos, sum(o.amount_eur) as overdue_value
from analytics.fct_wholesale_orders o join analytics.dim_wholesale_account a using (account_id)
where o.ship_window_end < current_date and o.status not in ('shipped', 'cancelled')
group by 1 order by 3 desc

entities.name: b2b
entities.sql:
select a.name, a.credit_limit_eur, sum(o.amount_eur) as open_value
from analytics.dim_wholesale_account a join analytics.fct_wholesale_orders o using (account_id)
where o.status in ('open', 'confirmed')
group by 1, 2 having sum(o.amount_eur) > a.credit_limit_eur

entities.name: Query 9
entities.sql:
select request_type, count(*) as late_requests
from analytics.gdpr_dsr_requests
where completed_at > received_at + interval '30 days'
group by 1

entities.name: dsr
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', received_at) as month, count(*) as erasure_requests
from analytics.gdpr_dsr_requests where request_type = 'erasure'
group by 1 order by 1

entities.name: Query 33
entities.sql:
select campaign, sum(spend_eur) / nullif(sum(clicks), 0) as cpc_eur
from analytics.fct_marketing_spend
where spend_date >= current_date - 30
group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: mkt tmp
entities.sql:
with rev as (
  select s.utm_source as channel, sum(o.net_amount_eur) as revenue
  from analytics.fct_web_sessions s join analytics.fct_orders_v2 o on o.customer_id = s.customer_id
   and o.ordered_at between s.started_at and s.started_at + interval '1 day'
  where s.converted group by 1),
spend as (select channel, sum(spend_eur) as spend from analytics.fct_marketing_spend group by 1)
select spend.channel, rev.revenue / nullif(spend.spend, 0) as roas
from spend left join rev using (channel)

entities.name: Query 2
entities.sql:
select device, avg(case when converted then 1.0 else 0 end) as conversion_rate
from analytics.fct_web_sessions where started_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
group by 1

entities.name: landing
entities.sql:
select landing_page, count(*) as sessions, avg(case when converted then 1.0 else 0 end) as cr
from analytics.fct_web_sessions
where utm_source is not null
group by 1 having count(*) > 100 order by 3 desc limit 20

entities.name: Query 19
price check
Query 40
entities.sql:
select case when r.reason_code like 'SIZE%' then 'sizing'
            when r.reason_code in ('DAMAGED', 'DEFECT') then 'damaged'
            when r.reason_code = 'CHANGED_MIND' then 'changed mind' else 'other' end as bucket,
       count(*) as returns
from analytics.fct_returns r
join analytics.fct_orders_v2 o using (order_line_id)
join analytics.dim_product p using (sku)
where p.category = 'Footwear'
group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: reconcile
entities.sql:
select s.psp_reference, s.merchant_reference, s.gross, s.settled_at
from analytics.stg_adyen_settlements s
left join analytics.fct_payments p on p.payment_id = s.merchant_reference
where p.payment_id is null

entities.name: Query 50
entities.sql:
with c as (select customer_id, date_trunc('month', signup_at) as cohort from analytics.dim_customer)
select c.cohort,
       count(distinct o.customer_id)::numeric / count(distinct c.customer_id) as m3_retention
from c left join analytics.fct_orders_v2 o on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
 and date_trunc('month', o.ordered_at) = c.cohort + interval '3 months'
group by 1 order by 1

entities.name: old orders
entities.sql:
select extract(year from created_at) as year, sum(gross_amount) as gross
from analytics.fct_orders where created_at < '2023-01-01'
group by 1 order by 1

entities.name: Refunds v2 FINAL
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('week', returned_at) as week, reason_code, sum(refund_amount) as refunded
from analytics.fct_returns where reason_code not like 'SIZE%'
group by 1, 2 order by 1

entities.name: DE numbers
carrier stuff
entities.sql:
select carrier, avg(cost_eur) as avg_cost, count(*) as shipments
from analytics.fct_shipments where promised_date >= current_date - 90
group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: churn (new def)
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', cancelled_at) as month, count(*) as voluntary_cancellations
from analytics.fct_subscriptions
where cancelled_at is not null and coalesce(cancel_reason, '') <> 'payment_failed'
group by 1 order by 1

entities.name: tickets wk
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('week', created_at) as week, category, count(*) as tickets
from analytics.fct_support_tickets group by 1, 2 order by 1

entities.name: PL orders
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', p.captured_at) as month, count(*) as blik_payments, sum(p.amount_eur) as amount
from analytics.fct_payments p
join analytics.fct_orders_v2 o on o.order_id = p.order_id
join analytics.dim_customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
where c.country = 'PL' and p.method = 'blik'
group by 1 order by 1

entities.name: margin check Q3
entities.sql:
select p.season, sum(o.net_amount_eur - o.quantity * p.cost_price) as margin
from analytics.fct_orders_v2 o join analytics.dim_product p using (sku)
where extract(quarter from o.ordered_at) = 3
group by 1

entities.name: Adyen fees
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', settled_at) as month, sum(commission) as commission
from analytics.stg_adyen_settlements group by 1 order by 1

entities.name: spend recon
entities.sql:
select spend_date, sum(spend_eur) as spend
from analytics.fct_marketing_spend where channel = 'TikTok'
group by 1 order by 1

entities.name: hr dash src
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', start_date) as month, department, count(*) as hires
from analytics.hr_employees group by 1, 2 order by 1

entities.name: wholesale pipeline
inventory inbound
entities.sql:
select w.name, sum(i.inbound_units) as inbound
from analytics.fct_inventory_snapshot i join analytics.dim_warehouse w using (warehouse_id)
where i.snapshot_date = (select max(snapshot_date) from analytics.fct_inventory_snapshot)
group by 1

entities.name: Refunds by product category
entities.description: Total refunded amount per product category, all time.

entities.name: Discount code revenue share by month
entities.description: Share of monthly net revenue that came from orders using a discount code.
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', ordered_at) as month,
       sum(net_amount_eur) filter (where discount_code is not null) / sum(net_amount_eur) as discounted_share
from analytics.fct_orders_v2 group by 1 order by 1

entities.name: On-time delivery rate by warehouse
entities.description: Share of shipments delivered on or before the promised date, per warehouse.

entities.name: Payment method mix
entities.description: Share of the total amount paid through each payment method.
entities.sql:
select method, sum(amount_eur) / sum(sum(amount_eur)) over () as share
from analytics.fct_payments group by 1

entities.name: Trail Club active members by plan
entities.description: Number of Trail Club members with an active subscription, per plan.
entities.sql:
select plan, count(distinct customer_id) as members
from analytics.fct_subscriptions where cancelled_at is null group by 1

entities.name: Employee headcount by department
entities.description: Current employees per department, excluding leavers.

entities.name: Average first response time by priority
entities.description: Average minutes until the first reply to a support ticket, per priority.
entities.sql:
select priority, avg(first_response_minutes) as avg_first_response
from analytics.fct_support_tickets group by 1

entities.name: NPS survey responses per month
entities.description: How many customers answered the NPS survey each month.
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', responded_at) as month, count(*) as responses
from analytics.fct_nps_responses group by 1 order by 1

entities.name: Inventory on hand by warehouse
entities.description: Units in stock per warehouse on the latest snapshot date.

entities.name: Wholesale revenue by account tier
entities.description: Shipped wholesale order value per account tier.

entities.name: GDPR requests backlog
entities.description: Data-subject requests that are still open, by request type.
entities.sql:
select request_type, count(*) as open_requests
from analytics.gdpr_dsr_requests where completed_at is null group by 1

entities.name: Click-through rate by campaign
entities.description: Clicks divided by impressions for each marketing campaign.
entities.sql:
select campaign, sum(clicks)::numeric / nullif(sum(impressions), 0) as ctr
from analytics.fct_marketing_spend group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: Web sessions by device and traffic source
entities.description: Number of website sessions per device type and UTM source.
entities.sql:
select device, coalesce(utm_source, 'direct') as source, count(*) as sessions
from analytics.fct_web_sessions group by 1, 2

entities.name: Average order value by channel
entities.description: Average net order value in EUR per sales channel.
entities.sql:
select channel, sum(net_amount_eur) / count(distinct order_id) as aov
from analytics.fct_orders_v2 group by 1

entities.name: Returns by reason code
entities.description: Number of returned items per return reason code.
entities.sql: select reason_code, count(*) as returns from analytics.fct_returns group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: Adyen settlement volume by day
entities.description: Gross amount settled by Adyen each day.
entities.sql: select settled_at::date as day, sum(gross) as gross from analytics.stg_adyen_settlements group by 1 order by 1

entities.name: New customers by signup month and country
entities.description: Customer signups per month, split by country.
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', signup_at) as month, country, count(*) as signups
from analytics.dim_customer group by 1, 2 order by 1

entities.name: Subscription cancellations by reason
entities.description: Trail Club cancellations per stated cancel reason.
entities.sql:
select cancel_reason, count(*) as cancellations
from analytics.fct_subscriptions where cancelled_at is not null group by 1 order by 2 desc

entities.name: Shipment volume by carrier
entities.description: Number of shipments handled by each carrier per month.
entities.sql:
select date_trunc('month', promised_date) as month, carrier, count(*) as shipments

entities.description: Average catalogue list price per product category.
entities.sql: select category, avg(list_price) as avg_list_price from analytics.dim_product group by 1
